# Differences from the private tree (generated by the build)

None changes a computation.

## `analysis/spec_lib.py`: repository root: one level up, not two

Before:

```
ROOT = os.environ.get("INDUS_ROOT") or os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..",
                                                                    ".."))
```

After:

```
ROOT = os.environ.get("INDUS_ROOT") or os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), ".."))  # deposit: analysis/ sits one level below the root (two in the private tree)
```

## `analysis/run_core.py`: git gate replaced by the manifest check

Before:

```
def gate():
    for path, blob in FROZEN.items():
        if git("diff", "--quiet", TAG, "--", path).returncode != 0:
            sys.exit("GATE: %s differs from the frozen tag; the run stops" % path)
        if git("rev-parse", "%s:%s" % (TAG, path)).stdout.strip() != blob:
            sys.exit("GATE: blob id of %s at the tag differs from FREEZE_RECORD; the run stops" % path)
    dirty = git("status", "--porcelain", "--", "submission/scripts_v2/spec_lib.py",
                "submission/scripts_v2/spec_lib_measures.py", "submission/scripts_v2/spec_lib_protocols.py",
                "submission/scripts_v2/run_core.py").stdout.strip()
    if dirty:
        sys.exit("GATE: the library has uncommitted changes; commit first so the outputs trace to a commit:\n" + dirty)



```

After:

```
def gate():
    """Deposit: the private repository's gate (git tag, blob ids, clean tree) is replaced by the manifest
    check: every shipped file must equal its SHA256SUMS.txt entry. No computation changes."""
    import deposit_gate
    deposit_gate.check(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))

```

## `analysis/run_core.py`: manifest check before the analysis imports

Before:

```
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)

```

After:

```
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
import deposit_gate  # noqa: E402  (deposit: the manifest is checked BEFORE any analysis module loads)
deposit_gate.check(os.path.dirname(HERE))

```

## `analysis/run_full.py`: git gate replaced by the manifest check

Before:

```
def gate():
    for path, blob in run_core.FROZEN.items():
        if run_core.git("diff", "--quiet", run_core.TAG, "--", path).returncode != 0:
            sys.exit("GATE: %s differs from the frozen tag; the run stops" % path)
        if run_core.git("rev-parse", "%s:%s" % (run_core.TAG, path)).stdout.strip() != blob:
            sys.exit("GATE: blob id of %s at the tag differs from FREEZE_RECORD; the run stops" % path)
    dirty = run_core.git("status", "--porcelain", "--", *LIB).stdout.strip()
    if dirty:
        sys.exit("GATE: the library has uncommitted changes; commit first:\n" + dirty)



```

After:

```
def gate():
    """Deposit: the private repository's gate (git tag, blob ids, clean tree) is replaced by the manifest
    check: every shipped file must equal its SHA256SUMS.txt entry. No computation changes."""
    import deposit_gate
    deposit_gate.check(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))

```

## `spec/PREREG_chronology.md`: the original test on the database's `time` field withheld (ICIT content)

Before:

```
(169 lines, from the heading "Why" to "Gates added": the registration, pre-run notes, results and deviation log of the withdrawn [S8] test; not reproduced, see the note in the file)
```

After:

```
## Sections withheld in this copy

The registration, pre-run notes, results and deviation log of the original within-period test (from "Why" to
"Gates added", 169 lines in the private repository) are not reproduced here. That test used the database's own
`time` field, the period-and-phase labels the database assigns, and its text quotes those labels, how they map onto
the recorded period and phase at each site, and row counts per label: content of the database, which this
repository does not publish. The test was withdrawn on 6 November 2026 and replaced by Amendment 1 below
(option B'), which uses the published excavation strata; the paper reports only B'.


```
